chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The people with the best faith are those who are best in character and most gentle with their families, and I am the most gentle of you with my family.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between faith and character in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to highlight the inseparable link between spiritual perfection and domestic etiquette, a core ten of Shia ethics. The Prophet’s self-reference as the most gentle with his family serves as a normative model for the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that true faith manifests in tender treatment of spouses and children. This tradition underscores that moral character is not merely an internal state but a relational practice rooted in the Prophet's own household.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-109 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
The people with the best faith are those who are good-tempered and treat their families with kindness. I am the best of you in treating my family with kindness.”
